_comment: Scene for the air wings and airbases screen. Renderer keys: 'windows' with 'at' (where the engine puts each top-level window on a 2560x1440 screen; leave it out to use the file's own position until it is measured with render_gui.py --verify), 'rows' and 'listRows' (sample rows per list), 'height', 'hide' and 'place' (what the code sizes, hides or moves in this state); 'samples' (texts for named text boxes). Harness keys: 'setup' (recipe steps from the clean state; see wiki/Game-Recipes.md), 'captures' (extra named captures with their own steps), 'expect' (widgets that must be visible in the capture: proof that the recipe brought the screen up), 'crop' (x, y, width, height cut out of a capture). 'manual' and 'checklist' are what is left for a human.

windows.name: air_selection_view
windows._note: The mission bar is filled by code with one button per mission the DLC allows and sized by it (slots x 52 + 2 x 16 from x 8: 820 with 15 missions); the render shows the Missions card without the buttons. strategic_air_priorities_window opens on a click.

windows.name: unassigned_airwings_view
windows._note: The code docks this frame at air_selection_view.y + air_selection.position.y: 77 + 91 = 168 measured with the 705 px build and 77 + 120 = 197 in vanilla ('atVanilla', measured with render_gui.py --verify). With the redesign (air_selection y 104) it is expected at 2,181; not measured in game yet. An air group badge pushes it further down. bottom_window is the footer of the unassigned list only.

airwing_selection_item.mission_state: On Mission in Western Mediterranean Sea

gun_emplacement_selection_item.mission_state: On Mission in Labrador and Newfoundland

rocket_selection_item.mission_state: On Mission in Western Mediterranean Sea

manual: Tooltips and click targets of the toolbar buttons and of the plates between them
A wing on a mission: mission icons and efficiency strip beside the green region name
shift+n creates an air group without also firing the airbase row's n (new wing); shift+u unassigns
Quick deploy popup: open it, scroll its list
Gun emplacement and rocket rows (none in a 1936 start)
checklist: Header: the mission buttons sit on the Missions card (52 px apart, the bar ends at the panel edge with 15 missions), the toolbar buttons on five plates, no map between the cards
The list frame starts 6 px into the header plate (expected y 181), 818 wide, 19 rows before scrolling
Wing rows: name in hoi_20b and status in hoi_18mbs, both whole; the two lines clear the row's bottom border
Close buttons of the toolbar, the airbase row and the wing rows in one column
Airbase row: name, 'Capacity' caption, capacity, quick deploy buttons growing left of the edit button
Give a wing a mission: the mission icons start 8 px right of the longest status
Open strategic air priorities: it opens above the mission bar as before
shift+n creates an air group; shift+u unassigns the selected wings
Scroll the list to the end
Quick deploy popup: open it, scroll its list
